fieldHelp.gallery.source: The media of items you pick, or images uploaded as assets.
fieldHelp.gallery.media: Each item shows its main media, or the media you pick. With no caption, the item's title is the caption.
fieldHelp.gallery.assets: The assets, in the order the gallery shows them.
fieldHelp.gallery.asset: The image this place in the gallery shows.
romekaField.gallery.caption: Caption
fieldHelp.gallery.caption: The text under the image and in the lightbox.
fieldHelp.gallery.layout: A grid crops each image to a square. Masonry keeps each image whole. A carousel scrolls sideways.
fieldHelp.gallery.columns: Images side by side, 2 to 6. A carousel shows this many at once. Phones show 2.
fieldHelp.gallery.captions: The caption shows under each image.
fieldHelp.gallery.lightbox: Selecting an image shows it large over the page, with arrows to the others. Without this, the image file opens.
fieldHelp.featuredItem.item: The item this card features. Its title links to the item.
fieldHelp.featuredItem.image: Where the item's main image sits. In a narrow column it always sits above the text.
fieldHelp.featuredItem.fields: The values the card lists, in this order. With none, the card shows the item's description.
fieldHelp.featuredItem.property: The card lists every value the item has in this field.
fieldHelp.featuredItem.link_label: The words of the link to the item. Empty shows "View item" in the site's language.
fieldHelp.button.button_label: The words on the first button.
fieldHelp.button.button_page: A page of this site, or a URL.
fieldHelp.button.button2_page: A page of this site, or a URL.
fieldHelp.button.style: Filled with the theme's button colour, or an outline in it.
fieldHelp.button.alignment: Where the buttons sit in the row.
fieldHelp.quote.text: The words quoted, without quotation marks.
fieldHelp.quote.attribution: The person or work the words come from.
fieldHelp.quote.item: Optional. The item the quotation comes from, linked after the name.
fieldHelp.quote.style: Plain sits in the text with a rule beside it. Large is centred in display type. Band also sets it on a coloured band.
fieldHelp.accordion.entries: Each heading opens its answer. Upstream Omeka S shows every answer open.
romekaField.accordion.heading: Question or heading
fieldHelp.accordion.heading: What a reader selects to open the answer. An entry with no heading is left out.
fieldHelp.timeline.source: Items you pick one by one, or every item a search finds.
fieldHelp.timeline.items: The timeline puts them in date order, whatever order you pick them in.
fieldHelp.timeline.query: The timeline places up to 500 items this search finds.
fieldHelp.timeline.property: Dates such as 1894, 1894-03 or 1894-03-12 place an item. Items without one are listed after the timeline.
fieldHelp.searchBox.placeholder: The hint in the empty field. Empty shows the site's "Search the collection".
fieldHelp.searchBox.resource: The whole site, with pages, or only the items or item sets.
